summary: LOOP-1 v1.1 add-ons validated end-to-end. All 31/31 backend tests pass (8 new add-on + 11 LOOP-1 v1 + 12 CORE-1). Frontend PatternAlertsCard renders 4 patterns (statement_anomaly_ready high, manual low, reclassification_review high, invoice_issue_review medium) on cathy's /app/me, positioned correctly between Financial Position and Open follow-ups. CaseDetail assignee dropdown renders with Unassigned + household members, selection persists after reload, and clearing to null persists (confirms Pydantic model_fields_set fix works). LCA-1 sweep idempotency, dry-run, digest body, and SLA nudge cooldown all pass.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' logged on every render. Source is emergent ai-devtools/visual-editor instrumentation injecting x-ve-dynamic <span> wrappers inside <option> children. Not caused by user code but pollutes console for all users hitting a case detail page.

critical_code_review_comments: loop1_addons.py — clean separation via init_addons DI, all four endpoints correctly gated by _assert_flag(). Aggregate pipeline for patterns is efficient (single group across accessible pids).
LCA-1 sweep idempotency correctly enforced via existing-case check keyed on dedupe_key `reclassification_review:oct2026:{pid}` BEFORE calling scanner — confirmed by second run returning opened:0.
Nudge cooldown uses 5-day case_events lookup; correct and idempotent.
Assignee PATCH bug fix (using payload.model_fields_set) verified end-to-end via UI: setting then clearing assignee both persist on reload.

Minor: PATTERN_HEADLINES fallback template joins on underscore replace — acceptable but 'manual' case_type has no headline entry so renders generic '7 open manual cases...' text (visible in UI). Consider adding a headline entry or hiding non-registered types.
Minor: digest hardcodes https://wayly-rn-build.preview.emergentagent.com/app in email body; should read from an APP_URL env var for prod portability.
seed_data_creation: LCA-1 sweep live run opened reclassification_review cases for cathy's Level-2/3 participants during test_lca1_sweep_live_is_idempotent — this is by design and matches E1's ship intent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four LOOP-1 v1.1 features (patterns, assignee, LCA-1 sweep+digest, SLA nudges) shipped clean. Only cosmetic notes: (a) 'manual' case_type falls through to generic headline template; (b) digest emails contain hardcoded preview URL; (c) React hydration warning from emergent ai-devtools injecting <span> inside <option> in CaseDetail — infra-level, not user code. Feature flag LOOP1_CASES_ENABLED=0 not exercised at runtime (would require backend restart) but code review confirms all four endpoints call _assert_flag() as first line.
